input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link is built from `BASE_URL`, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable is not set (src/notifications/templates.ts:8). In production this env var appears to be missing or not configured after last week's release, so the reset (and weekly rollup / export) links point at localhost for every recipient instead of the real public URL. Need to ensure `PUBLIC_URL` is set in the production environment, and likely make the app fail loudly (or avoid silently defaulting to localhost) when it's missing in a non-dev environment.
